# Enclosure Generation Skill

## Primary Tool: YAPP_Box

**Yet Another Parametric Projectbox** by Willem Aandewiel  
Repository: <https://github.com/mrWheel/YAPP_Box>  
License: **MIT** | Stars: 485+ | Version: v3.3.8 | Active since 2022  
Documentation: <https://mrwheel-docs.gitbook.io/yappgenerator_en/>

> **Why YAPP_Box over MakerWorld?** The `.scad` source is fully downloadable,
> MIT-licensed, CLI-renderable, version-controllable, and requires no account or
> browser. An LLM can generate the complete project `.scad` config file directly
> from project docs.

---

## Setup

Two files are required per project render:

| File | Role | Source |
|------|------|--------|
| `YAPPgenerator_v3.scad` | Library (do not edit) | Download from GitHub releases |
| `<project>-enclosure.scad` | Project config (LLM-generated) | Generated by this skill |

**Download the library once** into the project's `mechanical/enclosure/` directory:

```bash
# From repo root
curl -L https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrWheel/YAPP_Box/main/YAPPgenerator_v3.scad \
     -o <project>/mechanical/enclosure/YAPPgenerator_v3.scad
```

Or clone/download the YAPP release zip and copy the single file.

---

## CLI Render Commands

Requires [OpenSCAD](https://openscad.org/downloads.html) installed and on PATH.

```bash
# Render complete enclosure (box + lid together, side-by-side preview)
openscad --render -o reefs-box-full.stl reefs-enclosure.scad

# Render base only
openscad --render -o reefs-box.stl reefs-enclosure.scad \
         -D printLidShell=false

# Render lid only
openscad --render -o reefs-lid.stl reefs-enclosure.scad \
         -D printBaseShell=false

# Render at higher quality (slower)
openscad --render -o reefs-box.stl reefs-enclosure.scad \
         -D renderQuality=16 -D printLidShell=false
```

> Tip: For complex enclosures with many cutouts, increase OpenSCAD's max elements:
> Preferences → Advanced → "Turn off rendering at" → set to 500000 or higher.

---

## Box Dimensions

YAPP is PCB-centric, but for general enclosures use the **virtual PCB** approach:
set `pcbLength`/`pcbWidth` to your desired **inner dimensions** and set all
padding to 0. This gives direct inner-dimension control.

```
Total interior X (length, front-to-back) = pcbLength + paddingFront + paddingBack
Total interior Y (width, side-to-side)   = pcbWidth  + paddingLeft  + paddingRight
Total interior Z (height)                = basePlaneThickness + baseWallHeight
                                         + lidWallHeight      + lidPlaneThickness
Outer dimensions                         = interior + 2 × wallThickness (X and Y)
                                         + basePlaneThickness + lidPlaneThickness (Z)
```

**Key global parameters:**

```scad
// --- Box dimensions (inner) ---
pcbLength           = 144;  // total inner length (front-to-back, X axis)
pcbWidth            = 94;   // total inner width  (side-to-side, Y axis)
pcbThickness        = 1.6;  // PCB thickness (keep default if no real PCB)
standoffHeight      = 5.0;  // height to raise PCB off base floor
standoffDiameter    = 7.0;  // standoff outer diameter
standoffPinDiameter = 3.0;  // pin/hole diameter (3.0 = self-threading M3)
standoffHoleSlack   = 0.4;  // tolerance on pin hole

// --- Padding (set to 0 for virtual PCB approach) ---
paddingFront        = 0;
paddingBack         = 0;
paddingRight        = 0;
paddingLeft         = 0;

// --- Wall and floor/lid thickness ---
wallThickness       = 2.5;  // use 3.0 to match MakerWorld model
basePlaneThickness  = 1.5;
lidPlaneThickness   = 1.5;

// --- Wall heights (sum = total inner Z minus plane thicknesses) ---
baseWallHeight      = 28;   // typically ~55% of total inner height
lidWallHeight       = 23;   // remaining ~45%; ridgeHeight must ≥ lidWallHeight

// --- Lid connection ---
ridgeHeight         = 5.0;  // ridge overlap between base and lid
ridgeSlack          = 0.3;  // fit tolerance
roundRadius         = 3.0;  // corner rounding (mm); 0 = sharp
boxType             = 0;    // 0=all rounded, 1=all square, 2=chamfered

// --- Render control ---
printBaseShell      = true;
printLidShell       = true;
showSideBySide      = true; // preview only, no effect on STL
printerLayerHeight  = 0.2;
renderQuality       = 8;    // 1-32; higher = slower but smoother
```

---

## Coordinate System

All cutout arrays use:
- **`yappCoordBoxInside`** — origin at inner front-left corner of the box (most intuitive for enclosure design)
- **`yappCenter`** — position parameter points to the **center** of the hole
- **`yappOrigin`** (default) — position parameter points to the **corner** of the hole

For our standard enclosure workflow always use `yappCoordBoxInside, yappCenter`.

Face orientation (default, no rotation):

| YAPP array name | Physical face | Common use |
|-----------------|---------------|-----------|
| `cutoutsFront`  | Front wall (closest to you) | USB-C for programming access |
| `cutoutsBack`   | Back wall | Cable glands, IEC C14 inlet |
| `cutoutsLeft`   | Left wall (long side) | Barrel jack, switches |
| `cutoutsRight`  | Right wall (long side) | — |
| `cutoutsLid`    | Top (lid) | Display, buttons, label cutout |
| `cutoutsBase`   | Bottom floor | Ventilation, wall mounts |

---

## Cutout Array Format

```
cutouts<Face> = [
  //  [fromBack, fromLeft/bottom, width, height, radius, shape,
  //   optional: depth, angle, yappCoordBoxInside, yappCenter]
];
```

| Shape constant | Required fields | Notes |
|---------------|-----------------|-------|
| `yappRectangle` | `width`, `height` (p2, p3) | `radius` = 0 |
| `yappCircle` | `radius` (p4) | `width`, `height` = 0 |
| `yappRoundedRect` | `width`, `height`, `radius` | All three required |
| `yappPolygon` | `width`, `height` | Needs `yappPolygonDef` vector |

**Rectangle cutout example (IEC C14 on back wall):**
```scad
cutoutsBack = [
  // [fromBack, fromLeft, width, height, radius, shape, depth, angle, coord, origin]
  [10, 0, 28, 48, 0, yappRectangle, 0, 0, yappCoordBoxInside, yappCenter],
  //  ^pos from back (Z offset from floor), ^pos from left (Y center),
  //  ^W=28mm, ^H=48mm (IEC C14 standard cutout)
];
```

**Circle cutout example (PG9 cable gland, Ø16mm drill):**
```scad
cutoutsFront = [
  [30, 20, 0, 0, 8, yappCircle, 0, 0, yappCoordBoxInside, yappCenter],
  //  ^Z offset from floor, ^Y offset from left, radius=8 (Ø16mm), circle
  [30, 60, 0, 0, 8, yappCircle, 0, 0, yappCoordBoxInside, yappCenter],
  // second PG9 gland 40mm to the right of first
];
```

---

## PCB Standoffs

```
pcbStands = [
  // [posx, posy, optional: height, pcbGap, standoffDiam, pinDiam, holeSlack,
  //  n(a): yappBoth/yappLidOnly/yappBaseOnly,
  //  n(b): yappPin/yappHole/yappTopPin,
  //  n(c): corner anchor yappAllCorners / yappFrontLeft / yappBackLeft / etc.,
  //  n(d): coord system]
];
```

**4-corner standoffs for ESP32 DevKit (30×51mm, ~23×45mm hole pattern):**
```scad
pcbStands = [
  // Use yappAllCorners to place one standoff at each corner of a rectangle
  // defined by (posx, posy) = one corner, measured from PCB origin
  [3, 3, standoffHeight, 0, standoffDiameter, standoffPinDiameter,
   standoffHoleSlack, yappBoth, yappPin, yappAllCorners, yappCoordPCB],
];
// For explicit placement (4 individual standoffs):
// [x1, y1, ...], [x1, y2, ...], [x2, y1, ...], [x2, y2, ...]
// where x2-x1 = 45, y2-y1 = 23 (ESP32 DevKit hole spacing)
```

---

## Lid Connectors (Screw Posts)

```
connectors = [
  // [posx, posy, standHeight, screwDiam, screwHeadDiam, insertDiam, outsideDiam,
  //  n(a): corner, n(b): coord]
];
```

**4×M3 lid connectors at box corners:**
```scad
connectors = [
  [5, 5,  10, 3, 6, 4, 8, yappAllCorners, yappCoordBoxInside],
  // standHeight=10mm posts, M3 screw (Ø3), M3 flat head (Ø6), 
  // insert hole Ø4 (self-thread), outside post Ø8
];
```

---

## Labels

```scad
labelsPlane = [
  // [posx, posy, rotation, depth, face, font, size, "text"]
  [0, 0, 0, -0.5, yappLid, "Liberation Sans:style=Bold", 8, "REEFS"],
  // depth negative = raised text; depth positive = recessed/engraved
];
```

## Standard Component Cutout Dimensions

### Power Connectors

| Component | Shape | Dimensions | Notes |
|-----------|-------|-----------|-------|
| IEC C14 inlet | Rectangle | 28 × 48 mm | Standard panel-mount C14 |
| IEC C14 + switch | Rectangle | 28 × 54 mm | Taller variant with rocker |
| Barrel jack 5.5mm | Circle | radius = 4 mm (Ø8) | DC 5.5/2.1 |
| USB-C (panel cutout) | Rectangle | 9 × 3.5 mm | Align to PCB edge |
| USB-A | Rectangle | 12 × 7 mm | Standard Type-A |
| Micro-USB | Rectangle | 8 × 4 mm | Older ESP8266 boards |

### Cable Entry

| Component | Shape | Dimensions | Notes |
|-----------|-------|-----------|-------|
| PG7 cable gland | Circle | radius = 6.25 mm (Ø12.5) | Cable OD ≤ 6 mm |
| **PG9 cable gland** | Circle | **radius = 8 mm (Ø16)** | **Cable OD ≤ 8 mm — standard** |
| PG11 cable gland | Circle | radius = 9.25 mm (Ø18.5) | Cable OD ≤ 10 mm |
| JST SM 3-pin | Rectangle | 10 × 5 mm | Detachable connector |
| JST SM 2-pin | Rectangle | 8 × 5 mm | Detachable connector |

### Controls & Indicators

| Component | Shape | Dimensions | Notes |
|-----------|-------|-----------|-------|
| Tactile push button | Circle | radius = 3.5 mm (Ø7) | Flush mount |
| Standard toggle switch | Circle | radius = 6.5 mm (Ø13) | SPST/SPDT |
| 5mm LED | Circle | radius = 2.6 mm (Ø5.2) | |
| 3mm LED | Circle | radius = 1.6 mm (Ø3.2) | |
| OLED 0.96" display | Rectangle | 26 × 14 mm | Active area only |

---

## ESP32 DevKit Standoff Reference

Standard 38-pin ESP32-WROOM-32 DevKit:

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| PCB dimensions | ≈ 30 × 51 mm (wide 38-pin variant) |
| Mounting hole pattern | ≈ 23 × 45 mm (centre-to-centre) |
| Standoff height | 5 mm (clears bottom solder joints) |
| Standoff pin diameter | 3.0 mm (self-threading M3) |

> Verify your specific DevKit — dimensions vary by manufacturer (±1–2 mm).

---

## LLM Generation Workflow

When asked to generate an enclosure for a project:

### Step 1 — Read project docs
Read these files in order:
1. `<project>/specs.md` — constraints section, enclosure size target
2. `<project>/hardware/bom/bom.md` — all components with dimensions
3. `<project>/hardware/wiring/WIRING.md` — connector types and positions

### Step 2 — Inventory components

Build two lists:
- **Internal components**: footprint (L×W mm) and height, including wiring clearance
- **Face-mounted connectors**: which face, cutout size (from table above)

| Decision guide | Rule |
|----------------|------|
| Mains inlet (IEC C14) | Back wall or one short side |
| USB for programming | Front wall or side accessible when mounted |
| Cable glands (lamp cables) | Front wall or side, away from mains |
| Status LED / display | Lid or front wall |
| Multiple identical connectors | Same face, evenly spaced |

### Step 3 — Calculate dimensions

```
inner_L = max(pcbLength, widest_component_span_on_L_axis) + 10mm margin (5mm each side)
inner_W = max(pcbWidth, widest_component_span_on_W_axis) + 10mm margin
inner_H = tallest_component_incl_connectors + standoffHeight + 10mm clearance
→ round all up to nearest 5mm
→ verify outer (inner + 2×wallThickness) fits specs.md size constraint
```

### Step 4 — Generate the .scad file

Output a complete `<project>-enclosure.scad` that:
1. Sets `pcbLength`, `pcbWidth`, wall heights per the dimensions above
2. Sets all padding to 0 (virtual PCB approach)
3. Fills `cutoutsFront`, `cutoutsBack`, `cutoutsLeft`, `cutoutsRight`, `cutoutsLid` per the component layout
4. Fills `pcbStands` for the ESP32 DevKit standoff pattern
5. Fills `connectors` for M3 lid screws at 4 corners
6. Ends with `include <./YAPPgenerator_v3.scad>` — **this include must be the LAST line**

---

## Reefs Project — Worked Example

Target: 150×100×60mm outer (144×94×54mm inner), 3mm walls.

```scad
// reefs-enclosure.scad — generated 2026-05-16
// Render: openscad --render -o reefs-box.stl reefs-enclosure.scad -D printLidShell=false

printBaseShell      = true;
printLidShell       = true;
showSideBySide      = true;
printerLayerHeight  = 0.2;
renderQuality       = 8;

// --- Dimensions: 144×94×54mm inner → 150×100×60mm outer ---
pcbLength           = 144;   // inner length (front-to-back)
pcbWidth            = 94;    // inner width (side-to-side)
pcbThickness        = 1.6;   // ignored (virtual PCB)
standoffHeight      = 5.0;
standoffDiameter    = 7.0;
standoffPinDiameter = 3.0;   // M3 self-threading
standoffHoleSlack   = 0.4;

paddingFront        = 0;
paddingBack         = 0;
paddingRight        = 0;
paddingLeft         = 0;

wallThickness       = 3.0;
basePlaneThickness  = 1.5;
lidPlaneThickness   = 1.5;
baseWallHeight      = 28;    // 28 + 23 + 1.5 + 1.5 = 54mm inner height
lidWallHeight       = 23;
ridgeHeight         = 5.0;
ridgeSlack          = 0.3;
roundRadius         = 3.0;
boxType             = 0;

pcb = [
  ["Main", pcbLength, pcbWidth, 0, 0, pcbThickness,
   standoffHeight, standoffDiameter, standoffPinDiameter, standoffHoleSlack]
];

// --- PCB Standoffs: ESP32 DevKit 30×51mm, hole pattern 23×45mm ---
pcbStands = [
  [3,  3,  standoffHeight, 0, standoffDiameter, standoffPinDiameter, standoffHoleSlack,
   yappBoth, yappPin, yappFrontLeft,  yappCoordPCB],
  [48, 3,  standoffHeight, 0, standoffDiameter, standoffPinDiameter, standoffHoleSlack,
   yappBoth, yappPin, yappFrontRight, yappCoordPCB],
  [3,  26, standoffHeight, 0, standoffDiameter, standoffPinDiameter, standoffHoleSlack,
   yappBoth, yappPin, yappBackLeft,   yappCoordPCB],
  [48, 26, standoffHeight, 0, standoffDiameter, standoffPinDiameter, standoffHoleSlack,
   yappBoth, yappPin, yappBackRight,  yappCoordPCB],
];

// --- Lid connectors: 4×M3×8mm flat-head screws ---
connectors = [
  [5, 5, 12, 3, 6, 3.2, 8, yappAllCorners, yappCoordBoxInside],
];

// --- Cutouts ---

// Back wall: IEC C14 inlet (28×48mm) centered at height 30mm, horizontal center
cutoutsBack = [
  [47, 30, 28, 48, 0, yappRectangle, 0, 0, yappCoordBoxInside, yappCenter],
];

// Front wall: 2× PG9 cable glands (Ø16mm), one per lamp cable
cutoutsFront = [
  [20, 30, 0, 0, 8, yappCircle, 0, 0, yappCoordBoxInside, yappCenter],
  [60, 30, 0, 0, 8, yappCircle, 0, 0, yappCoordBoxInside, yappCenter],
];

// Right wall: USB-C access for OTA (9×3.5mm), aligned to ESP32 USB port height
cutoutsRight = [
  [25, 12, 9, 3.5, 0, yappRectangle, 0, 0, yappCoordBoxInside, yappCenter],
];

cutoutsLeft  = [];
cutoutsLid   = [];
cutoutsBase  = [];

// --- Label ---
labelsPlane = [
  [0, 0, 0, -0.5, yappLid, "Liberation Sans:style=Bold", 10, "REEFS"],
];

// --- Snap / Mount (none for this project) ---
snapJoins  = [];
boxMounts  = [];
lightTubes = [];
pushButtons = [];
displayMounts = [];

include <./YAPPgenerator_v3.scad>
```

---

## Output Files

| File | Description | Committed? |
|------|-------------|------------|
| `<project>-enclosure.scad` | YAPP config (LLM-generated source) | ✅ Yes |
| `YAPPgenerator_v3.scad` | YAPP library | ✅ Yes (pin to release) |
| `enclosure-spec.md` | Human-readable parameter summary | ✅ Yes |
| `<project>-box.stl` | Rendered base (from CLI) | ❌ `.gitignore` |
| `<project>-lid.stl` | Rendered lid (from CLI) | ❌ `.gitignore` |

Add to `<project>/.gitignore`:
```
mechanical/enclosure/*.stl
```

---

## MakerWorld Alternative

If you prefer a GUI workflow or need a specific aesthetic, the MakerWorld
**Customizable Project Enclosure Box** (ID 952727, by MrPractical) covers the
same use case:

- URL: `https://makerworld.com/en/makerlab/parametricModelMaker?designId=952727&modelName=CustomProjectEnclosureV1.7.8b.scad`
- Requires Bambu Lab account to download STL
- `.scad` source is NOT downloadable (protected)
- No CLI rendering — browser-only
- Use this option if you want the MrPractical aesthetic and are already in the MakerWorld ecosystem

> **Recommendation**: Use YAPP_Box for all new projects. Use MakerWorld only
> when you specifically need its aesthetic or already have a `.3mf` saved from it.

---

## Tips

- **Self-threading standoffs**: set `standoffPinDiameter = 3.0` (M3). The printed plastic will thread as the screw is driven in. No heat inserts needed for light PCBs.
- **Fit between base and lid**: increase `ridgeSlack` (default 0.3) to 0.4–0.5 if the lid is tight.
- **Render timeout**: use `renderQuality = 4` for quick test renders; `renderQuality = 16` for final print-quality STL.
- **Version pin**: commit the exact `YAPPgenerator_v3.scad` version alongside your project config. Do not point to a URL at render time.
- **Venting**: for PSU natural convection, add vents to `cutoutsBase` or side walls using a grid of small rectangles.
